371:t_1:89.en:
$$勝平$$
「Like I give a damn about that jerk!」

371:t_1:91.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「It looks like $$勝平$$ and $$ワッ太$$ are still fighting...」

371:t_1:92.en:
$$マオ$$
「Leave them alone. They say even a dog won't get involved in that kind of fight.」

371:t_1:93.en:
$$宗介$$
「That saying is about fights between married couples.」

371:t_1:94.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Oh... You know a pretty clever expression for once, $$宗介$$.」

371:t_1:95.en:
$$甲児$$
「I guess hearing it over and over about you and $$かなめ$$ paid off.」

371:t_1:97.en:
$$カイエン$$
(It looks like $$宗介$$ has come to terms with what happened to $$かなめ$$.)

371:t_1:98.en:
$$シュレード$$
(Our vice president is the one we should be concerned about.)

371:t_1:99.en:
$$甲児$$
「Anyway, once I hear 'volunteering,' I can't just sit back.」

371:t_1:100.en:
$$宗介$$
「Hmm... It's been a while since I felt my blood boiling like this.」

371:t_1:101.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Come on, $n. Our president, $$アルト$$, is off at the $$残されの海$$, so the vice president has to take charge.」

371:t_1:102.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「We're counting on you, $n. Fire everyone up.」

371:t_1:103.en:
$n
「...Weren't we going to hold a new election now that the term has changed...?」

371:t_1:104.en:
$$宗介$$
「With our president, manager, and advisor all absent, you're the only one we can rely on.」

371:t_1:105.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Or I could take command for you. Your illustrious Master Sergeant.」

371:t_1:106.en:
$n
「Are you running for Master Sweeper instead of Master Sergeant?」

371:t_1:107.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Why, you little...! That's a lousy pun!」

371:t_1:108.en:
$n
「I'm sorry, but I'll be the one to protect the Volunteer Club.」

371:t_1:109.en:
$$カイエン$$
「You're getting back into the swing of things.」

371:t_1:110.en:
$$ボス$$
「Of course he is. Our vice president's drive is something else.」

371:t_1:112.en:
$n
「This is your vice president addressing all members! Wherever we are, our volunteer spirit stays the same!」

371:t_1:113.en:
$n
「Once you've got your plastic bags and work gloves ready, start picking up trash!」

371:t_1:114.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So it's the same old thing after all!?」

371:t_1:115.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Give up, $$ワッ太$$. This was decided the moment $n said he was taking command.」

371:t_1:116.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh... I guess volunteering is too much for $$ワッ太$$, who cares more about the company safe than world peace.」

371:t_1:117.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You asked for it, $$勝平$$! Don't underestimate my trash-picking skills!」

371:t_1:118.en:
$$赤木$$
「All right...! Then let's see which of you can collect more trash!」

371:t_1:119.en:
$n
「$$勝平$$, $$宇宙太$$, $$恵子$$. You're honorary Volunteer Club members today too. I need you to work hard.」

371:t_1:121.en:
$$シンジ$$
($n... It looks like he's overcome the shock of Miss $$スズネ$$ being kidnapped...)

371:t_1:122.en:
$$シンジ$$
($n is... strong... I could... never be like him...)

371:t_1:123.en:
$$カヲル$$
「It's all right, $$シンジ$$. You can keep moving forward in your own way.」

371:t_1:124.en:
$$赤木$$
「$$カヲル$$ is right. Come on... You're a Volunteer Club member too, so let's get moving.」

371:t_1:125.en:
$$いぶき$$
「$$郁絵$$ and our $$谷川$$ are helping with the food distribution, so lunch should be good too.」

371:t_1:126.en:
$$青山$$
「If $$ミサト$$ were here, she'd probably say nothing beats a beer after hard work.」

371:t_1:128.en:
$$青山$$
(It looks like bringing up $$ミサト$$ was a mistake...)

371:t_1:129.en:
$$赤木$$
(We'd better stay away from that subject.)

371:t_1:130.en:
$$カレン$$
「Hey, $$シンジ$$... Where are $$アスカ$$, $$レイ#pt394$$, and $$マリ$$?」

371:t_1:132.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's our first Volunteer Club activity in a while. You should have invited them.」

371:t_1:137.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Come on, $$シンジ$$! Let's work with effort, guts, and a spirit of service!」

371:t_1:138.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Look... Big Sis is quietly picking up trash too.」

371:t_1:139.en:
$$チコ$$
「I'm surprised... Princess is actually eager to do this kind of thing.」

371:t_1:140.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I can't just stand by when I see Earth being polluted.」

371:t_1:141.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's my Big Sis! $$ノノ$$ is so moved!」

371:t_1:143.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Huh... There are skylarks here. Maybe it's because we're near the mountains.」

371:t_1:145.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's the name of that bird. I told you before, remember?」

371:t_1:146.en:
$$チコ$$
「Another surprise...! Princess knows all about bird names!」

371:t_1:147.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ノノ$$ saw a swan on a mission once. It apparently got her interested in birds, and now she keeps pestering me about them.」

371:t_1:148.en:
$$チコ$$
「And that's how you learned so much.」

371:t_1:149.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You're kind, $$ラルク$$, studying birds for $$ノノ$$'s sake.」

371:t_1:150.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I-It's nothing like that! I was just interested in them myself!」

371:t_1:152.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ノノ$$, quit giving me that creepy smile! If you want to set an example for $$シンジ$$, get to work!」

371:t_1:153.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes, ma'am! $$ノノ$$ will now devote all her strength to picking up trash!」

371:t_1:155.en:
$$カヲル$$
「This sort of thing is nice too.」

371:t_1:161.en:
$n
(That's why I need to get back on my feet soon... For everyone, for Miss $$スズネ$$, and for myself.)

371:t_1:162.en:
$n
(When I feel down, I move my body... Now's the time to get back to basics.)

371:t_1:165.en:
$n
(Using no way as way, using no limitation as limitation...)

371:t_1:166.en:
???
「Wow...! That dance just now... was amazing!」

371:t_1:169.en:
$n
「It's the name of the martial art I practice.」
